description: This file defines the 'Factorial' class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, implementing mathematical functions related to factorials such as factorial, double factorial, and multinomial calculations.

classes.name: Factorial
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate factorials, double factorials, and multinomial coefficients for use within spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: fact
methods.description: Calculates the factorial of a number, returning the product of all positive integers up to the given number, or handling special cases and errors.

methods.name: factDouble
methods.description: Calculates the double factorial of a number, which multiplies every second number from the given number down to 1 or 2.

methods.name: multinomial
methods.description: Computes the multinomial coefficient as the ratio of factorials, given multiple input values.
